bounds.domain: Three turns, two rooms, at most two leases or waiters per room, a total limit of three or four, and one outstanding write per room per turn. Same-room nested reuse leaves ownership unchanged. Widening refuses the nested call and can unwind the outer lease.
bounds.limitations: The real queue suite exercises ambient ownership, nested reuse, widening refusal and released-lease continuation. It does not replay the generated schedules for saturation, close, cancellation or writes. The PostDeliveryTasks suite separately exercises write-tail ownership.

stateRepresentation: The source variables form one typed record. Every action updates that record atomically and retains all other fields.

No scheduler fairness is assumed by this property.

The stated fairness is an assumption about enabled model actions; runtime scheduling and provider completion are not proved.
